brief:
Netanyahu requested that the UAE's president issue a public denial that he warned Israel's prime minister ahead of Hamas's October 7 attack, the Ma'an news agency reported. The request emerged during Netanyahu's secret visit to Abu Dhabi on Sunday, according to the Associated Press.

Details of any warning and the specific circumstances of Netanyahu's request remain unclear from the accounts of the visit.
dek: Netanyahu requested that the UAE's president issue a public denial that he warned Israel's prime minister ahead of Hamas's October 7 attack, the Ma'an news agency reported.
title: Netanyahu asks UAE leader to publicly deny warning him before October 7
